output.summary: Review 1 fixes in a9e604b. C1: a Story base tip above the checked commit is taken only as clean merges of the base branch whose tree equals git merge-tree; an evil merge, a forged merge or a merge of another branch is re-verified (real-git tests). C2: Story PRs are head-bound (a merged PR counts only at the current tip), fork PRs are ignored, addTasks ends the approval and re-merges touched repos, reportVerify keeps merged repos, and the approval is re-read before each merge. I1: a merge refused because the base moved is re-verified. I2: a failing Story no longer holds the claim tick, and its problem is shown on the Story page. I3: new tests. I4: team finish rechecks pre-D48 Stories. M1: a left-over record is renamed. RED 13/132 on 4a84203 -> GREEN 2026/2026; tsc 0.
